text:
Morgan: Morning — quick sync re: new intake 'Nimbus-14B'. Product wants this prioritized for low-latency chat (mobile). Can we agree on a short scorecard and immediate experiments?
Cesar: +1. Target is <120ms p99 on 2-token prompt on rtx-a10. Rough capacity estimate: 60 req/s per GPU at fp16.
Anya: did a first-pass eval on instruction-following. Noise up vs baseline. Short snippet of results:```
metric, nimbus14b, baseline
exact_match, 0.84, 0.88
instr_fidelity, 0.78, 0.86
latency_fp16(ms), 108, 95
```
Lina: thanks Anya — can you drop those test prompts in the intake ticket? I want to see prompt-level diffs.
onboard-bot: Intake created: INF-4321 | Nimbus-14B | requester=product | target=chat-mobile | priority=high
Cesar: checklist proposed: 1) FP16 end-to-end baseline, 2) q4f16 + q8 trial, 3) KV-cache perf & mem, 4) eval suite + hallucination probes, 5) rollout plan canary 5% dedicated.
Morgan: I like that. Let's add a quality gating rule: any downgrade >3% absolute on instr_fidelity blocks rollout. Also add latency SLO: p99 <= 140ms.
Anya: will run baseline + q4f16 tomorrow AM. Quick note: q4f16 causes longer tail on some long-context tasks — might need KV tuning.
Cesar: for scoring, propose weights: quality 0.5, latency 0.3, cost 0.15, stability 0.05. We can compute a normalized score after experiments.
Lina: can we also try compiler flags: kernel=auto vs kernel=optimized for long-seq? small A/B might help.
Morgan: yes — include kernel variants in the experiment matrix.
Anya: adding experiment matrix to INF-4321: ```
- fp16/baseline
- q4f16 (default kernels)
- q4f16 (optimized kernels + kv-cache tweak)
- q8_0 trial
- distilled-8b fallback check
```
Cesar: timeline: fp16 baseline + q4f16 perf by EOD Wed, full eval by end of week. If quality drops beyond gate, we evaluate fallback to smaller model or adjust quant profile.
Lina: ops note — if we need dedicated for canary, give me heads-up by Thu morning to reserve nodes.
onboard-bot: Update INF-4321: experiment matrix added by Anya.
Morgan: decision checklist for this thread: - Run fp16 baseline (owner: Anya) - Run q4f16 + kernel variants (owner: Cesar) - Run hallucination suite (owner: Morgan) - Compute priority score and recommend rollout (owner: Lina)
Cesar: quick command to start perf run on infra:```
run_infer --model nimbus-14b --mode perf --batch 1 --seq 128 --quant fp16 --out perf_fp16.json
```
Anya: running that now, will paste perf logs when done.
Lina: we should tag alerts for regression monitoring if canary goes live: perf, cost, correctness.
Morgan: agreed. Final: score threshold 0.7 for green. If normalized score <0.7 -> keep in bench queue. Everyone ok?
Cesar: ok from infra side.
Anya: ok.
Lina: ok, reserving canary window Thurs.
onboard-bot: INF-4321 status=In Progress, watchers=[Morgan,Cesar,Anya,Lina]
